profile.name: USB光谱仪
profile.description: 用于实验室光谱测量的USB光谱仪，可采集一维光谱，部分型号支持区域扫描；某些配置集成激光、温控、快门、风扇、外触发和模拟量接口，常用于拉曼与一般光谱分析。
profile.description_en: A USB spectrometer for laboratory spectral measurements. It acquires 1D spectra, and some models support area scanning. Certain configurations integrate an excitation laser, temperature control, shutter, fan, external triggering, and analog I/O for Raman and general spectroscopy.

registry.name: Feature Identification
registry.description: Feature Identification Device是一款表征设备，主要功能包括使能、光谱采集、写入数据、复位、扫描、日志记录。支持Signal, Slot, apply edc等操作。
